listing.name: Rebalanced Doom
listing.summary: Rebalances the Starlight Cabal Doom ship by reducing mine range and removing mine deployment while phasing to make it less overpowered.
listing.aiSummary: Rebalances the Starlight Cabal Doom ship by reducing mine range and removing mine deployment while phasing to make it less overpowered.

description:

Affects the Starlight Cabal Doom from Underworld as well.

Active changes

Removes the ability to deploy mines while phasing.Reduces the range of the mine strike system from 1500 to 800.

Goal of the mod

descriptionHtml:
DownloadCan be added during a campaign.
Can be safely removed from a campaign.
Affects the Starlight Cabal Doom from Underworld as well.

Active changes
  • Removes the ability to deploy mines while phasing.
  • Reduces the range of the mine strike system from 1500 to 800.


Goal of the mod
  • Make the Doom less annoying to play against and less overpowered to play as.
  • Make it harder and riskier to use well.
  • Keep its core identity as a backstabbing ship intact.
  • Make sure that the AI is able to use the changed ship well.
  • Do it with as few changes as possible.


Footage of the changes in action

No skills and normal loadout.

Optimized loadout with skills against 2 radiant remnant fleet.
aiDescription: This mod adjusts the Starlight Cabal Doom to be less annoying to fight and less dominant to pilot. It reduces the mine strike system range from 1500 to 800 and prevents mine deployment while phasing. The goal is to keep the ship's backstabbing identity while making it riskier to use effectively.
